summary.text: Kim Moser is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 64 since 2017 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her as Kimberly Moser and she chairs the Health and Family Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kim Moser, listed by Ballotpedia as Kimberly Poore Moser, was born in Taylor Mill, Kentucky.
She earned a BSN and an RN from Spalding University.

Her career experience includes working as a flight nurse, as a director with the Northern Kentucky Office of Drug Control Policy, and as president of the AMA Alliance, and she has been a member of the American Society of Addiction Medicine.
In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Health and Family Services Committee and also served on the Families and Children and House Judiciary committees.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
